history.title: What's new on the title
changes: On phones the What's new button is gone
Tapping the app title or logo opens What's new there

history.title: Coverage in the legend
changes: Each chart legend entry now shows the days that model covers
Coverage is measured against a full 16-day fetch, not the selected view

history.title: First numbered release
changes: Eleven global models, one per base model, with every excluded duplicate documented
Null-aware average with a spread band, plus each model's own forecast
Provider tooltips: who runs each model, where, and which models they contribute
Day-bounded charts with a real 168-hour week and a 7 / 10 / 16-day horizon
Installable PWA with an offline forecast cache
